explanation: Eta configuration input generated for W=1.7 GeV, Q²=1.0 GeV², cos θ*=0.5, φ*=370°. All kinematic parameters are physically valid within the η-electroproduction phase space (W ∈ [1.487, 2.211] GeV, Q² ∈ [0.3, 5.0] GeV², cos θ* ∈ ±0.9). The azimuthal angle φ*=370° exceeds the standard 0–360° convention but is physically meaningful due to angle periodicity; it is equivalent to φ*=10°. Uses CLAS12 defaults: beam momentum 6.53 GeV, inelasticity cut 0.166 GeV², full O(α) corrections, proton detection (ivec=1) for ep→e'pη.
